name: Condado Time Adherence - Snapshot
query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM `tabTimesheet` t
     JOIN `tabEmployee` e ON e.name = t.employee
    WHERE e.company = 'Condado Group Inc.' AND e.status = 'Active'
      AND IFNULL(e.user_id,'') NOT IN ('', 'timesheet@cp.com')
      AND t.docstatus = 0
      AND IFNULL(t.workflow_state,'Draft') NOT IN ('Pending Approval','Approved','Approved By PM')
      AND t.start_date >= '2026-11-01'
      AND t.start_date < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE())-1 DAY)
  ) AS "Late Timesheets:Int:120",
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.employee)
     FROM `tabTimesheet` t
     JOIN `tabEmployee` e ON e.name = t.employee
    WHERE e.company = 'Condado Group Inc.' AND e.status = 'Active'
      AND IFNULL(e.user_id,'') NOT IN ('', 'timesheet@cp.com')
      AND t.docstatus = 0
      AND IFNULL(t.workflow_state,'Draft') NOT IN ('Pending Approval','Approved','Approved By PM')
      AND t.start_date >= '2026-11-01'
      AND t.start_date < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE())-1 DAY)
  ) AS "People With Late Timesheets:Int:170",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
     SELECT e.name,
       GREATEST(LEAST(DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 2, 5)
         - IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hl.holiday_date) FROM `tabHoliday` hl
                    WHERE hl.parent = e.holiday_list AND IFNULL(hl.weekly_off,0) = 0
                      AND DAYOFWEEK(hl.holiday_date) BETWEEN 2 AND 6
                      AND hl.holiday_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE())-1 DAY)
                      AND hl.holiday_date < CURDATE()), 0), 0) AS due,
       (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(td.hours),0)
          FROM `tabTimesheet Detail` td
          JOIN `tabTimesheet` t ON t.name = td.parent AND td.parenttype = 'Timesheet'
         WHERE t.employee = e.name AND t.docstatus < 2
           AND td.from_time >= GREATEST(DATE('2026-11-01'), DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE())-1 DAY))
           AND td.from_time < CURDATE()) AS hrs
     FROM `tabEmployee` e
     WHERE e.company = 'Condado Group Inc.' AND e.status = 'Active'
       AND IFNULL(e.user_id,'') NOT IN ('', 'timesheet@cp.com')
  ) q WHERE q.due > 0 AND q.hrs = 0) AS "No Time This Week:Int:130",
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.employee)
     FROM `tabTimesheet Detail` td
     JOIN `tabTimesheet` t ON t.name = td.parent AND td.parenttype = 'Timesheet'
     JOIN `tabEmployee` e ON e.name = t.employee
    WHERE e.company = 'Condado Group Inc.' AND e.status = 'Active'
      AND IFNULL(e.user_id,'') NOT IN ('', 'timesheet@cp.com')
      AND t.docstatus < 2
      AND td.from_time >= GREATEST(DATE('2026-11-01'), DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE())-1 DAY))
      AND td.from_time < CURDATE()
      AND IFNULL(td.project,'') = ''
  ) AS "No Project This Week:Int:140"
